condition:
native WT DyP-loaded encapsulin purified from 
M. smegmatis mc2 155; endogenous CFP-29 shell containing cognate DyP cargo
notes:
Canonical native DyP-loaded WT T=1 assembly. Tang et al. 2021 isolated the endogenous CFP-29/DyP nanocompartment 
from M. smegmatis and directly reported a ~24 nm, ~2.5 nm-thick icosahedral shell composed of 60 CFP-29 subunits. The cargo is one dodecameric DyP complex (two hexamers) spanning the lumen. PDB 7BOJ / EMD-30130 represents the shell; PDB 7BOK / EMD-30131 represents the cargo and EMD-30132 the complete loaded particle, so 7BOK is not listed as a shell structure_id. Later tdNfsB-loaded shell structures 9FN9 / 9FNA retain the same global T=1 architecture and differ mainly in five-fold pore conformation, so they are not treated as separate assemblies. No distinct cargo-free WT assembly has been structurally characterized for this accession.
shell_sequence_change: No engineered alteration of the WT shell protein is recorded for this assembly.
